key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil surge pressured miners and banks
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare; oil price surge adds inflationary pressure
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate path
ANZ.AX restructuring 3,500 jobs; banks under pressure amid rising bond yields
Housing prices crashing with first-home buyer surge; no spring bounce in auctions
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy fears; Santos preservation noted
Mining cap raises accelerating (Canaccord-led), signalling capital stress in junior sector
Gold/silver exploration active (Kuniko, Gateway WA) as safe-haven demand persists

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting' phase; major miners (BHP, RIO, FMG) under pressure. Junior miners raising capital (Canaccord-led dash). Gold/silver explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA) gaining interest on safe-haven flows.
sectors.implications: Short-term headwinds for iron ore names; rotation into gold/silver and critical resources (battery tech). Cap raises dilute equity holders in juniors.

sectors.trend: Banks sending ASX tumbling on rising bond yields and rate-rise fears. ANZ.AX executing 3,500-job cut; restructuring still early. Superannuation policy debate adds regulatory overhang.
sectors.implications: NIM pressure from rate uncertainty; cost-cutting supports margins but signals weak growth. Super policy risk (populism vs. stability) a medium-term concern.

sectors.trend: Oil 'explodes' as price suppression fails; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c. Australia softened gas supply rules, easing Asian LNG fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic priority.
sectors.implications: Positive for Woodside.AX, Santos.AX, OilSearch.AX on oil/gas prices. Higher fuel costs feed into inflation, complicating RBA path.

sectors.trend: Housing prices crashing; first-home buyers surging. No spring bounce in auctions. Woolworths breached its own 'Price Freeze' on staples. Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: Negative for property REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) and construction. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) face margin pressure from input costs vs. pricing power limits.

sectors.trend: Limited ASX-specific news. Global pharma (Novo Nordisk, Merck, BioMarin) active but peripheral. ASX small-caps (Neurizon, Iondrive) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX likely to benefit from global pharma sentiment. Small-cap tech/biotech showing resilience in risk-off.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears and RBA rental inflation concern driving bond yield spike
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 200 heavyweight miners
AUD weakness on growth scare; oil surge creating stagflationary risk
Housing correction accelerating; policy response uncertain
Mining sector capital stress: cap raises and dilution risk in juniors
Superannuation policy debate: populism vs. system integrity
Energy security: gas supply rule changes and Santos strategic role

risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; favour rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities with hedged exposure; watch 10-yr GBA yields
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold (NVS.AX, SGH.AX) and critical resources
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented earners; monitor AUD/USD 0.62 support
Overweight energy (WDS.AX, STO.AX); underweight transport and consumer discretionary
Monitor NAB.AX/CBA.AX loan growth; reduce property REIT exposure; watch auction clearance rates
Avoid pre-announcement juniors; favour cash-flow-positive producers over explorers

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and critical resources on safe-haven and battery-tech demand
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore weakness and AUD crash support gold; battery tech (Critical Resources) and gold-silver (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer diversification

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil surge and gas supply rule easing
opportunities.rationale: Oil price suppression failing; Australia's gas rule changes support LNG exporters; Santos strategic role affirmed

opportunities.recommendation: Selective first-home buyer / construction plays on housing correction
opportunities.rationale: Housing price crash driving buyer surge; affordable housing builders and mortgage brokers may see volume uplift

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore heavyweight exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; structural demand concerns from China; ASX $90bn drawdown led by miners

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce property REIT weightings
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; housing correction with no spring bounce; rental inflation complicates RBA easing

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash / short-duration bonds as rate uncertainty persists
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern keeps rate path uncertain; bond yields rising; defensive positioning prudent

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to test lower supports as iron ore weakness, AUD sell-off, and oil-driven inflation fears persist. RBA rental inflation commentary keeps rate-cut hopes at bay. Expect volatility in miners and banks; energy and gold relative outperformance. $90bn weekly drawdown may extend.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term recovery contingent on iron ore stabilisation, RBA pivoting to easing if growth data weakens, and housing market finding a floor. Superannuation policy clarity and energy security reforms (gas rules, Santos) provide structural support. AUD likely to remain range-bound until growth trajectory clarifies.
key_catalysts: Iron ore price trajectory (China stimulus signals)
ANZ.AX restructuring progress and cost savings
Housing auction clearance rates and first-home buyer data
watch_list: Iron ore spot price (62% Fe) and Chinese steel demand
RBA cash rate and rental inflation index
ANZ.AX / CBA.AX loan growth and NIM
NZ housing correction spillover to Australia
